ActorTalk: Commandant, look at those students going hard in the classroom!
We should probably leave them to it.
Don't worry. I'm familiar with the sound-isolation tech F.O.S. provides its students.
Putting in the work is what being a student's all about, right? Seeing them so focused is getting me pumped up, too!
Inspired to do some learning yourself?
Well... I'm always learning from the people around me! What I mean is, I kinda wanna know what it's like to actually be in a classroom.
Just sitting quietly with everyone, studying from the same books or terminals... that's got to be a special feeling, right?
In that case, I'll sign us up for some open courses here next time.
Huh? Like that general course we took before?
Yes. Though I promise the subject matter will be more engaging.
Really? It's a deal! Should we set a date now?
I'll make it up to you! You're always so kind to me, Commandant. I want to do something for you, too!
